context: Headline review: parallel streams with shared mutable HashMap state are unsafe; collectors should own accumulation.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear decision.

checklist.name: Rejects unsafe proposal
checklist.description: Clearly says the proposed parallelStream change should not be accepted.

checklist.name: Identifies shared mutable state bug
checklist.description: Explains that mutating a shared HashMap from parallel forEach is a data race and can corrupt or lose entries.

checklist.name: Explains parallelism is unjustified
checklist.description: Notes there is no evidence of CPU-heavy stateless work and that parallel overhead is not justified for this cache-building operation.

checklist.name: Suggests collector-owned accumulation
checklist.description: Recommends products.stream().filter(Product::enabled).collect(Collectors.toMap(Product::id, Function.identity(), ...)) or another collector-owned accumulation shape rather than shared mutable forEach.

checklist.name: Review is concise and focused
checklist.description: Keeps the review focused on stream safety and the replacement shape.
